name: 23502 · Norfolk, VA
findings: ZIP 23502 (Norfolk) has 181 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23502 (Norfolk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23502 (Norfolk) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
